Making governance visible to the people accountable for it. If the board cannot see it, it will not be resourced.

| [Board Pack Template](board-pack.md) | <span class="pill ready">Ready</span> | A structured report that gives the board what it needs to discharge its oversight duty: current posture, what changed, what went wrong, and what… |
